verdict.rationale: Nitrokey makes hardware security keys and a self-hosted NetHSM appliance. Keys and data live on the physical device the user holds, not in a vendor-hosted cloud, so choosing a storage region or residency is a cloud-service axis that does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Nitrokey offers a hosted data-storage service with region selection that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
